description: This file defines the CustomRouter class implementing Symfony's RouterInterface, providing a custom routing mechanism that delegates URL generation and context setting to underlying components.

classes.name: CustomRouter
classes.description: A custom implementation of Symfony's RouterInterface, encapsulating URL generation and route collection handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CustomRouter with a URL generator and route collection.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the request context for URL generation.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current request context from the URL generator.

methods.name: getRouteCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of routes managed by the router.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a URL based on route name and parameters.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a path info to a route; currently a placeholder.
